text:
Sam: Heads-up: nightly GPU matrix is red. Multiple A100 shards failing with driver/runtime warnings + OOMs. failing run: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/6123

ci-bot: [automated] Run 6123 failed on runner gpu-a100-7. Summary: CUDA runtime/driver mismatch, Xid 31 (watchdog reset), and a CUDA out-of-memory in the inference step. Full logs: https://ci.redwood.example/logs/6123

Diego: quick skim of logs: first a warning `cuda runtime 515.86 vs driver 470.129` then stack shows allocation for kv cache failing. stack excerpt below. looks like memory pressure then kernel reset.

Aliza: we shipped allocator changes last Friday (commit f2e1a7) to align blocks for perf. Could be increasing observed reservation for long sequences. I'll start a bisect across recent allocator commits.

Nina: reproducing locally now with the nightly image. command I ran: `docker pull redwood/ci:nightly-gpu && docker run --rm -it redwood/ci:nightly-gpu bash -c "pytest tests/gpu/test_inference.py::test_long_sequence -q"`

Nina: local error snippet:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.8 GiB (GPU 0; 40.00 GiB total; 37.95 GiB already allocated)
  File "server/runner.py", line 198, in generate
    outputs = model.forward(batch)
  File "server/model/kv_cache.py", line 84, in reserve
    raise RuntimeError("KV reserve failed: requested {}".format(size))

Kernel report: Xid 31: GPU watchdog reset
```

Sam: if local repro hits OOM immediately that's a bad sign. Diego, can you patch CI matrix to lower the default max_seq for nightly while we triage? temporary mitigation only.

Diego: will open small PR fix/ci-lower-maxseq, setting max_seq=512 for nightly GPU tests and note it must be reverted. Link when done.

ci-bot: [automated] Bisect job created: https://ci.redwood.example/bisect/319. Bisecting commits f1d2c3..f3e4g5.

Aliza: bisect first midpoint fails and narrows to f2e1a7. Confirmed: reverting f2e1a7 locally removes the OOM and kernel reset. Preparing revert PR.

ops-bot: Infra note: several runners still on older driver 470.x images; infra rolling update to 515 drivers scheduled in next 30m. Might explain some mismatches across nodes.

Diego: PR for CI mitigation created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/4122 (label: fix/ci-mitigation). I added a changelog entry to revert after root-cause fix.

Aliza: Revert PR for allocator change opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/4130. Asking for expedited review.

ci-bot: [automated] PR 4130 merged by Aliza. Triggering full nightly GPU matrix rerun.

Sam: thanks. we'll monitor the rerun. If flakes persist after revert + driver roll, escalate to infra oncall. For now keeping the mitigation in place until we confirm green. :white_check_mark:

Nina: left a minimal repro script and instructions in ticket: https://go.redwood/tickets/4387#repro (includes docker command and pytest invocation).

Diego: I'll watch the rerun and follow up if any nodes still report driver/runtime mismatch.

Sam: closing this thread for now; reopen if CI flakes reappear or the repro changes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
